name: URTC-FLASHER
build: Standalone Python desktop tool. pip install -r requirements.txt; Qt Quick CAN-OTA deck is started with --qtquick.
notes: Real GUI flashing tool (CAN-OTA + full-chip SWD/JTAG). Qt Quick is the shared command-deck renderer for the real CAN-OTA flow; the established Tkinter UI remains the default until advanced SWD/JTAG parity is complete.
